column1: # Terms translate.py asks the model to keep consistent (D-019). Each is translated the way
# Windows itself and established download managers say it in the target language.

column2: meaning
noun: a file being fetched or fetched already; verb: to fetch a file from the internet
an ordered list of downloads that run one after another or a few at a time
a group of downloads by file type (Compressed, Documents, Music, Programs, Video)
one network connection to the server; a download uses several at once
continue a stopped download from where it stopped (not "summary")
stop a download for now, keeping what was fetched
a piece of a file fetched over its own connection
the window that starts and stops queues at set times
the feature that caps download speed
MDM taking over downloads from a web browser through its extension
a web browser add-on (not a file name extension) unless the note says file extension
the kind of a file, given by its extension (.zip, .mp4)
where parts are stored before the file is complete
the folder where the finished file goes
a .torrent file or a BitTorrent download
a magnet: link to a torrent
sharing a finished torrent with other peers
another computer in a torrent swarm
a torrent tracker server
the Windows clipboard
a proxy server
a hash (MD5, SHA-256) that verifies a file
finding the video or audio on a web page
